usage.outputShape: body.data[] — each activity: .id, .name, .description (HTML), .geoCode{latitude,longitude}, .price{amount,currencyCode}, .pictures[], .bookingLink, .minimumDuration. Total match count at body.meta.count.
quirks: Query params are required: latitude, longitude, radius (km), max. No request body (GET).
Amadeus tours & activities backend; descriptions are HTML strings.
Sibling routes on same service: /api/activities/by-square?north&south&east&west&max and /api/activities/details?activityId (the activityId comes from data[].id of a search).
price.currencyCode is often EUR, not USD.
usage.guide: Call GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/activities/search with query params latitude, longitude, radius (in km), and max (result cap). It pays $0.05 USDC via x402 on Base, no auth, fully synchronous. Read results from body.data[] — each item has name, description, price{amount,currencyCode}, geoCode, pictures[], and a bookingLink; total matches are in body.meta.count. To get full detail for one activity, take its .id and call /api/activities/details?activityId={id}.
